indicators.title: feat(lab): indicators, spec format, engine, lab run (harness PR 4)
indicators.summary: PR 4 of the harness upgrade (`docs/harness-upgrade-design.md`, "Order of PRs"). With this PR, bots can write a YAML spec and score it on discovery with `lab run`. Every run is logged as a trial. ## Commits 1. **`fix(lab)`: your review nits from #6** - **NaN Sharpe:** a trial with a NaN Sharpe now counts in `n_trials`. It is only left out of the Sharpe variance. - **Missing signal-day bar:** benchmarks now use each name's last liquidity reading on or before the signal day, so a name that skipped that session isn't dropped. - **Names that stop trading:** carrying them at their last close is now…
